To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

linear precoding and scaling can achieve a sum-rate capacity of the multi-user MIMO broadcast channel, and that the minimum rate can be maximized by solving a quasiconvix problem, and the BER can be minimized by solving a convex problem.

the precoding matrix that maximizes the sum rate is the solution to the following problem: maximize the sum of all singular values, subject to the constraints that the sum of all squared elements in each column of the precoding matrix be less than or equal to 1.
linear precoding with signal scaling can significantly increase the sum-rate of a multi-antenna channel, and that the minimum rate among users can be maximized by a simple bisection method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of practical linear precoding techniques that maximize the achievable rate in the multi-antennas broadcast channel.
the design of linear preprocessing schemes that maximize the sum rate of multi-antenna channels, while minimizing average BER.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the linear preprocessing technique proposed in this paper is a good choice in multi-antennabroadcast channels, and that the proposed precoding and scaling schemes are efficient and easy to implement.
the proposed scheme outperforms channel inversion, in terms of both sum rate and BER, in a wide range of scenarios.
the proposed scheme is a good candidate for practical multi-user MIMO systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for the case of linear processing, our scheme is optimal in terms of the sum-rate criterion, and it is near-optimal in terms of the minimum-rate criterion.
we have developed a new technique for multi-antenna downlink transmission with linear preprocessing.
, in multi-antennas broadcast channel, linear preprocessing can be used to achieve the sum rate capacity, and that signal scaling can be used to reduce BER without sacrificing sum rate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the linear preprocessing approach, the sum rate criterion and minimum rate criterion yield very similar precoder designs.
the sum rate and BER performance of a multi-antenna communication system can be significantly enhanced by employing the proposed signal scaling scheme in combination with linear preprocessing.
linear processing can provide a practical solution to the multi-antennas broadcast channel.
